name: NFS II SE Vita
author: veitorman
description:
Native PlayStation Vita port of Need for Speed II: Special Edition for PC.
This port is based on the NFS Recompiled project and adapts the game to run natively on PlayStation Vita ARM hardware.
The project includes Vita-specific implementations and adaptations for memory management, rendering, audio, input, filesystem access, application startup and packaging.
The port also includes a custom pre-launch configurator designed specifically for the Vita version.
